question: Will Derby County beat Cardiff City?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Derby County score more goals than Cardiff City by the end of the 90 minutes (plus any referee-added stoppage time) in their EFL Championship match on 22 August 2026 at Pride Park Stadium.
- "No": Wins if Cardiff City score more goals than Derby County by the end of the 90 minutes (plus any referee-added stoppage time) in that match.
- "Draw": Wins if both teams score an equal number of goals by the end of the 90 minutes (plus any referee-added stoppage time) in that match.

Clarifications:
- The result is determined by the official full-time score after 90 minutes plus stoppage time; extra time and penalty shootouts are not considered even if played.
